settings.question: 1. How can I list my designer outfit with nostringscouture?
settings.answer: Simply fill out our submission form with details of your garment, including the designer, original purchase price, condition and photographs. Our team will review your submission and get in touch with the next steps. Here is the upload link

settings.question: 2. Can I choose whether to rent or sell my outfit?
settings.answer: Absolutely. You can indicate whether you’d prefer to rent, sell or explore both options. Our team will assess your garment and recommend the most suitable option based on its style, condition and potential demand.

settings.question: 3. Is there a fee to list my garment?
settings.answer: There is no upfront fee to submit your garment for consideration. Any applicable commission or service charges will be communicated and agreed upon before your garment is listed.

settings.question: 4. How is the rental or selling price of my garment determined?
settings.answer: Our team recommends pricing based on factors such as the designer, original retail value, condition, age, style and current market demand. The recommended price and applicable commission will be shared with you for approval before listing.

settings.question: 5. Will I have to give my garment to nostringscouture?
settings.answer: Depending on the listing arrangement, we may require your garment to be physically available with us for quality checks, storage, fittings, rentals or sale fulfilment. Our team will communicate the requirements before proceeding.

settings.question: 6. What happens after my garment is accepted?
settings.answer: Once accepted, we will coordinate the necessary quality checks, photography and listing details. Your garment will then be showcased on our platform, making it accessible to customers looking to rent or purchase designer wear.

settings.question: 7. Will nostringscouture promote my garment?
settings.answer: Yes. We handle the presentation and promotion of garments listed on our platform through our website and relevant marketing channels. While we aim to maximise visibility, rentals and sales depend on customer demand.

settings.question: 8. Can I list more than one garment?
settings.answer: Of course! You can submit multiple designer pieces for consideration. Each garment will be reviewed individually to ensure it meets our curation and quality standards.

settings.question: 9. Can I list a garment that has been worn?
settings.answer: Yes. We accept select pre-loved designer garments that are in excellent condition. Each piece undergoes an evaluation to ensure it meets our standards for quality, authenticity and overall presentation.

settings.question: 12. Can I change the selling or rental price after listing?
settings.answer: You can contact our team to request a pricing revision. Any changes will be reviewed and mutually agreed upon, subject to existing bookings or confirmed transactions.

settings.question: 13. What happens if my garment is lost, stolen or severely damaged while listed with NSC?
settings.answer: We take appropriate precautions when handling and storing garments. However, unforeseen circumstances may arise during storage, transportation, fittings or rentals. Any loss, theft or significant damage will be assessed and handled in accordance with the terms agreed upon at the time of listing, including any applicable liability

settings.question: 14. What happens once my garment is sold?
settings.answer: Once a sale is successfully completed, we will coordinate the fulfilment process and arrange for your agreed earnings to be transferred in accordance with the payment terms.

settings.question: Can I purchase garments from nostringscouture?
settings.answer: Yes! Alongside our rental collection, we offer a curated selection of designer garments available for purchase. Explore beautiful pieces from coveted designers at prices below their original retail value.

settings.question: 2. Are the garments available for purchase new or pre-owned?
settings.answer: Our collection may include both new and pre-loved designer pieces. Each product listing will specify the garment’s condition, allowing you to make an informed purchase.

settings.question: 3. Are all the designer garments authentic?
settings.answer: Authenticity is central to our curation process. We assess garments before accepting them onto our platform to ensure they meet our standards. Any available authenticity documentation can be requested from our team.

settings.question: 4. How do I know the condition of a pre-loved garment?
settings.answer: Every pre-loved piece is evaluated before being listed. We aim to provide accurate descriptions and photographs highlighting its condition, including any notable signs of wear or imperfections.

settings.question: 5. Can I try on a garment before purchasing it?
settings.answer: Selected garments may be available for in-store trials by appointment. Please contact us to confirm availability and arrange a fitting.

settings.question: 6. Can I request additional photographs or videos before purchasing?
settings.answer: Absolutely. Our team can assist with additional photographs, videos and garment details to help you make a confident purchase decision.

settings.question: 7. Can purchased garments be altered to my measurements?
settings.answer: Alteration options depend on the garment’s construction, fabric and existing measurements. Our team can advise you on the alterations that may be possible before you complete your purchase.

settings.question: 8. Are purchased garments cleaned before delivery?
settings.answer: Pre-loved garments are evaluated and prepared before dispatch. Where appropriate, professional cleaning is arranged based on the garment’s fabric, embroidery and embellishments.

settings.question: 10. Can I negotiate the selling price of a garment?
settings.answer: Prices are determined based on the garment’s designer, condition, original value and other relevant factors. If you’re interested in a particular piece, our team can assist with any pricing-related enquiries.

settings.question: 11. Can I reserve a garment before purchasing it?
settings.answer: Please contact our team to enquire about reserving a garment. Reservations, where available, are subject to confirmation and applicable payment terms.

settings.question: 12. Can I rent a garment first and purchase it later?
settings.answer: Certain garments may be available for both rental and purchase. If you fall in love with a piece, contact our team to check whether purchasing it is an option.

settings.question: 13. Do you deliver purchased garments across India?
settings.answer: Yes, we offer delivery across India, subject to serviceability. Shipping timelines and applicable charges will be communicated during the purchase process.

settings.question: Do you have a physical store?
settings.answer: We have display area for our outfits in Delhi. Visit us at M11, 1st & 2nd Floor, Part 2, Main Market, Greater Kailash II, New Delhi, Delhi 110048

settings.question: How do I place an order?
settings.answer:
Step 1: Select the outfit that fits best for your occasion and book on our website or get in touch with us

Step 2: Provide your latest measurements for the best fit

Step 3 : We will customize your choice of product for your given dates

Step 4: . Garment will be delivered to you for 4 days for your special occasion

Step 5: Garment is picked up by us after the defined period. We will stay in touch with you throughout the process and confirm your measurements to make sure your selected garment fits like a glove for your chosen occasion

settings.question: How many days can we keep the garment?
settings.answer: We always want you to have enough time on your hands! For that, we provide either currently offer a 4-day rental option. However, if you need the outfit for longer, just reach out to us and we will book it for your desired number of days depending on availability.

settings.question: How early or late can I book my garment?
settings.answer: We are happy to help you pre-plan for your occasion and book an outfit for you as early as 3 months in advance (it’s a first come-first couture game with us!). We are also here to help you with your last-minute requirements and can take orders 7 days before your chosen dates depending on your city.

settings.question: When do I pay for the one-time wear garment?
settings.answer: For credit/debit/Paytm/bank transfer, you can pay latest 7 days before your chosen date.

settings.question: Where do you deliver?
settings.answer: We deliver Pan-India !

settings.question: Can I extend my one-time wear period?
settings.answer: If you need to keep your rental for longer, please contact us at +919958005809 we will do our best to accommodate your request

settings.question: Can I buy my one-time wear outfit?
settings.answer: Yes you can! Reach out to us if your interested in purchasing one of our rental outfits and we can let you know all the details.

settings.question: How do I return the one-time wear garment outfit after wearing it?
settings.answer: Place the outfit back in our garment bag and box it came in. You will be provided a shipping label. Please stick it on your box and our representative will pick it up on the last day of your selected rental date. That simple!

settings.question: How do I make my payment?
settings.answer: You can pay using a credit card, debit card or net banking. We also offer COD depending on your location

settings.question: How do I share my measurements?
settings.answer: You can share your measurements with us when you book your outfit on our website, or on WhatsApp before making the booking.

settings.question: Are outfits customised to my measurements?
settings.answer: Yes- we want them to fit you perfectly. They will be altered to your size.

settings.question: What is the purpose of the security deposit?
settings.answer: The security deposit is a refundable assurance in case of any accidental damage on the outfit. We conduct a quality check after receiving the outfit back from you and return the security deposit afterwards if there is no permanent damage.

settings.question: How much is the security deposit?
settings.answer: It is equal to the amount of your one-time wear and refunded 10 business days after returning the garment back to us

settings.question: What if the garment is damaged on return?
settings.answer: Please treat couture like it’s meant to be treated – delicately! However, if you do damage your one-time wear, you may be liable to pay a fee depending on the extent of damage. Most of it is on the house and is covered as part of our cleaning process and customizations. However sometimes, outfits are damaged beyond repair. In such cases, we reserve the right to evaluate each case individually and take a call depending on the life of the garment and disclose charges accordingly.

settings.question: What happens if a garment is lost or severely damaged?
settings.answer: Incase of significant or irreparable damage, loss, or failure to return a garment, additional charges may apply based on the extent of the damage and the value of the piece.

settings.question: How do I trust the one-time wear to be my perfect fit?
settings.answer: Couture should feel like it was made just for you and that’s exactly what we aim to achieve. After you reach out regarding your choice of garment, we will reach out to you personally to confirm your measurements to make sure we do our best. We recommend providing your latest measurements and getting measured by a tailor for best accuracy.

settings.question: How do you ensure hygiene of your outfits?
settings.answer: We maintain our couture carefully by having a cleaning process in place that includes stain removal and dry cleaning of the garment between uses. We have experts in place to handle the entire process. Our commitment is providing a garment that feels new when you receive it!

settings.question: Do I need to clean the garment before returning it?
settings.answer: No. You enjoy wearing the piece and simply return the garment to us as is.

settings.question: Do you offer refunds?
settings.answer: Once outfit is delivered to you, we are unable to offer refunds. You can cancel upto 2 weeks before your delivery for a refund.

settings.question: How can I cancel my order?
settings.answer: If you need to cancel your order, please call us at +919958005809. We will be unable to cancel your order 14 days before delivery and will return the refundable security deposit in such cases.
